title: Graduate Research Scholarships – 2028 Main Round
field: All research fields (higher degree by research)
about: The University of Wollongong's 2028 main round of graduate research scholarships, including the Australian Government Research Training Program and University Postgraduate Award, is open to international applicants until 23 May 2027 for Autumn 2028 starts. Outcomes are expected in mid-August 2027.
